# deck.gl 9.0.36 (vendored)

`deck.min.js` is the unmodified `dist.min.js` UMD bundle from the npm package
[`deck.gl@9.0.36`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/deck.gl/v/9.0.36), the same version the
Ethical Tech CoLab 3D agentic simulation pins. It is vendored rather than loaded from a CDN
so the site works offline and makes no third-party requests. MIT licence: see `LICENSE`.
